explication: Microsandbox is a cross-platform local microVM platform for isolating untrusted workloads. Users initiate work through the CLI or language SDKs: choose or pull an OCI image, create/run and manage a sandbox, then inspect it, execute commands, or save and restore snapshots. The repository separates host-side control, guest agent and VM execution, image/filesystem handling, networking, and persisted sandbox state. The README documents the product workflow and capabilities; several subsystem links below are dashed where sampled source did not expose their wiring.
